headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightTerminalCorrectedWordLaw_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightTerminalCorrectedWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k

headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)

  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ) (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)
  (R : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightTerminalCorrectedRetryWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k fallback R =

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWordWidth_le_old
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWordWidth xs ys t ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWordWidth xs ys t

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWordLaw xs ys htotal hb t =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWordLaw xs ys htotal hb t

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (t : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWordLaw xs ys htotal hb t)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
    Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTightPositiveReferenceWordWidth_eq

∀ (xs ys : List ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTightPositiveReferenceWordWidth xs ys t =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightPositiveReferenceWordWidth xs ys t
